name.title: What's your name?
name.description: Hosts and guests see your first name and the first letter of your last name.

phone.title: Your phone number
phone.description: We send a 6-digit code by SMS. Hosts use this number to reach you once a booking is confirmed.
phone.descriptionNoCode: Hosts use this number to reach you once a booking is confirmed.

birth.title: Your date of birth
birth.description: You must be at least 18 to book on BLADUS. Your birthday is never shown to anyone.

languages.title: Your languages
languages.description: Choose the language of the site, and the languages you speak so hosts can talk with you.

home.title: Where do you live?
home.description: Optional: it helps hosts know you a little. Only the commune is shown on your profile.
